description: This file contains a manual testing handler for Mattermost, including functions to set up test environments, create users and teams, and perform specific test cases like 'autolink'. It defines a TestEnvironment struct, a ManualTest function, and a helper getChannelID function.

classes.name: TestEnvironment
classes.description: A helper struct used for setting up test parameters, client, context, and request/response objects during manual testing.

methods.name: ManualTest
methods.description: Main handler function for setting up and executing manual tests based on URL parameters, including user and team creation, login, and test case execution.

methods.name: getChannelID
methods.description: Helper function to retrieve a channel ID by name within a team for a given user.
